hmda.source: Committed HMDA New Jersey slice (data/hmda/new-jersey/county_market_summary_nj.csv), Monmouth County row. Properties located in Monmouth County. Not a second national download.
hmda.caveat: HMDA describes reporting institutions in the statutory HMDA universe for properties located in this county. It does not describe all lending activity. Denial rate is denials divided by applications. It is not a quality score, approval probability, or fair-lending conclusion. Disparity does not prove discrimination.

njhmfa.copy: Eligible borrowers may qualify for up to $15,000 in NJHMFA Down Payment Assistance, plus $7,000 first-generation assistance where eligible (potential combined up to $22,000).
njhmfa.caveat: County of the property does not by itself qualify a borrower. Amounts are 'up to' and require program eligibility. NJHMFA participation is not an endorsement.
njhmfa.source: Smart Start Plus / First Generation fact sheet and current NJHMFA program pages, reused from NJ-LEND-003.

land_records.operator: Office of Records Management, Monmouth County Clerk
what_users_can_research: consideration / sale price on deed records where present
land_records.copy: The official Monmouth OPRS search lets the public look up recorded deeds, mortgages, trade names, block/lot identifiers, and consideration where present, plus Tax Board MOD-IV and sales queries. A land-record search is not a title report. A recorded mortgage is not a current loan balance.

sheriff.source_name: CivilView SalesWeb foreclosure listing (Monmouth County Sheriff)
sheriff.sale_schedule_note: Sheriff sales are held every other Monday at 1:00 p.m. at the Monmouth County Sheriff's Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, Freehold, NJ 07728.
semantics: Scheduled is not a completed sale.
Adjourned is not a completed sale.
Bankruptcy is not a completed sale.
No Purchased/Sold rows were present on this snapshot.
CivilView is a public summary listing, not an official record of title.
sheriff.copy: On the 2026-09-03 CivilView snapshot, 99 listings were present: 34 scheduled, 62 adjourned, 3 bankruptcy-related, and 0 completed sales. A scheduled or adjourned listing is not a completed foreclosure. Defendant names and property addresses are not published here.

property.source_name: NJGIN Parcels and MOD-IV Composite of NJ (Web Mercator), COUNTY='MONMOUTH' filter
property.daniels_law: OWNER_NAME is redacted on the public web service per Daniel's Law. This page does not publish owner names.
property.copy: NJGIN reports 249,796 parcel/MOD-IV features in Monmouth County. Parcel count is not a housing-unit or household count. Assessment value is not appraised market value. Owner names are not shown.

findings.title: 2025 mortgage application mix
findings.body: The committed 2025 HMDA county slice recorded 26,425 applications, 15,448 originations, and 4,341 denials for properties in Monmouth County (16.43% denial rate, denials ÷ applications). Purchase applications were 37.79% of applications and refinance applications were 34.02%. Conventional applications were 90.72% of the county mix, with FHA 6.94%, VA 2.30%, and USDA/other 0.04%. Denial rate is not a quality score.

findings.title: NJHMFA down-payment geography
findings.body: Monmouth is in NJHMFA's 12-county group. Eligible borrowers may qualify for up to $15,000 in Down Payment Assistance, plus $7,000 first-generation assistance where eligible (potential combined up to $22,000). County of the property does not by itself establish borrower eligibility.

findings.title: Sheriff-sale status snapshot, not completed-foreclosure counts
findings.body: The 2026-09-03 CivilView listing had 99 rows: 34 scheduled, 62 adjourned, 3 bankrupt, and 0 completed sales. Scheduled, adjourned, and bankruptcy statuses are not completed sales. This is a status inventory, not a foreclosure marketing list.

lender_discovery.copy: Use the New Jersey lender catalog and the existing Monmouth County catalog page to research lenders. A headquarters or city listed in this county does not mean the lender serves only this county. HMDA county activity is not a New Jersey license roster. Individual mortgage loan originators are not published from this page.
